### ① Derived judgments

Judged against origin/main `b94a2a7277857d1bad1153e0ce5b34d9d89d50b5`. The PR is one commit, prose-only, touching `content/docs/protocol/kernel/lifecycle.mdx` (+51/−63). Line numbers below for the page are at head.

1. TRUE — "the `os` CLI has no `upgrade` command" (lifecycle.mdx:16-17, 872, 879). `packages/cli/src/commands/**` at origin/main contains no `upgrade.ts` and no `upgrade/` directory; the only "upgrade" hits are prose inside `doctor.ts:1803,1960` and `i18n/check.ts:17`. `packages/cli/README.md` has zero occurrences of "upgrade".
2. TRUE — "The `os plugin` group is `build`, `sign` and `publish` only; there is no `os plugin install`, `enable` or `test`" (lifecycle.mdx:19-21). `packages/cli/src/commands/plugin/` holds exactly `build.ts`, `publish.ts`, `sign.ts`. `packages/cli/README.md:147-149` lists the three; `README.md:151` "The group has no `install`".
3. TRUE — ADR-0025 "records the install half (download, verify, materialize, load) as not yet implemented" (lifecycle.mdx:21-24, 198-202, 384-385). `docs/adr/0025-plugin-package-distribution.md` exists at origin/main; its status line (`:3`) reads "The code-plugin half of the install flow (§3.5 steps 4–7: download / verify / materialize / load) … remain unimplemented: … there is no `os plugin install` command, no `.osplugin` loader, and no runtime path on which a distributed plugin's code executes". §3.5 (`:215-238`) is the install-flow design the page's "Installation Flow (design)" sketch refers to. The GitHub `blob/main/docs/adr/0025-plugin-package-distribution.md` URL therefore resolves.
4. TRUE — "the install half … has no command and no runtime path" (lifecycle.mdx:200-201). Same ADR-0025:3 sentence ("no runtime path on which a distributed plugin's code executes").
5. TRUE — "Runtime plugins declared in `objectstack.config.ts` `plugins` are loaded automatically by `os serve` / `os dev`, and are bundled into the build artifact. To distribute a build, publish it as a package with `os package publish`" (lifecycle.mdx:374-378). Verbatim from `packages/cli/README.md:141`; `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts:1331` "`config.plugins` are always loaded", `serve.ts:1446` loads each `plugins: [...]` entry; `dev.ts:22-27,41,105` spawns/derives from the `serve` child.
6. TRUE — "Packages are installed into a running runtime with `os package install` (a catalog id or a compiled artifact file)" (lifecycle.mdx:379-380). `packages/cli/src/commands/package/install.ts:33` description "Install a package into a running ObjectStack runtime (catalog id or local artifact file)"; `:44` arg "Package manifest id (e.g. com.acme.crm) OR a path to a compiled artifact JSON"; `:98-139` file-vs-catalog mode switch. `README.md:134` "`os package install` … installs into a running runtime".
7. TRUE — "or into an environment by publishing with `os package publish … --env <env-id> --install`" (lifecycle.mdx:380-381). `packages/cli/src/commands/package/publish.ts:347-356` declares `env` ("Environment id to install the new version into after publish") and `install` ("Auto-install the new version into --env after publishing"); `README.md:101,115`.
8. TRUE — "Code-bearing plugins (a directory carrying an `objectstack.plugin.json` manifest) are packaged and shipped with `os plugin build`, `os plugin sign` and `os plugin publish`" and "a published `.osplugin` has no `os` command that installs it" (lifecycle.mdx:382-386). `README.md:143,147-151`; `packages/cli/src/commands/plugin/build.ts:4-18,67,89` (loads `objectstack.plugin.json`, emits `<id>-<version>.osplugin`); no install command per item 2.
9. TRUE — "`os test` is real: it runs qa/*.test.json scenarios against a running server" / `os test --url <url>` (lifecycle.mdx:876-877). `packages/cli/src/commands/test.ts:357` "Run Quality Protocol test scenarios against a running server", `:377` files arg default `'qa/*.test.json'`, `:381` `url` flag (default `http://localhost:3000`); `README.md:157`.
10. TRUE — the `[CLI reference]` link target `packages/cli/README.md` exists at origin/main (lifecycle.mdx:372-373).
11. TRUE — `/docs/plugins` resolves (lifecycle.mdx:389): `content/docs/plugins/index.mdx` exists ("Plugin system — extend the runtime safely"); `apps/docs/source.config.ts:47-48` maps `content/docs` and `apps/docs/lib/source.ts:18` sets `baseUrl: '/docs'`.
12. TRUE — anchors `#plugin-installation` and `#what-an-author-does-today` resolve: headings `## Plugin Installation` (lifecycle.mdx:195) and `### What an author does today` (lifecycle.mdx:370) slug to exactly those ids under fumadocs' github-slugger.
13. TRUE — "The boot sequence is implemented as described" (lifecycle.mdx:27) is a restatement of the pre-existing callout sentence (lifecycle.mdx:10-12), unchanged in substance; not a new claim.
14. TRUE — Summary bullet "ADR-0025 calls for transactional, all-or-nothing plugin installs; code-plugin installation is not implemented yet" (lifecycle.mdx:915): ADR-0025 §3.5 `:217-238` + status `:3`.
15. TRUE — "Treat those command snippets as design intent" expanded to say the `objectstack upgrade …` lines are not runnable (lifecycle.mdx:16-17, 574, 872, 879): item 1.
16. Dev's finding — `packages/cli/package.json` declares both `objectstack` and `os` bins: TRUE. `packages/cli/package.json:22-25` `"bin": { "objectstack": "./bin/run.js", "os": "./bin/run.js" }`. So the page's mix of `objectstack …` (design-intent lines) and `os …` (real lines) is consistent with a shipped alias; the page's `os`-prefixed claims are the ones measured here.

Census (rest of the page, outside the diff, at head): no occurrence of `plugin install`, `plugin enable`, `plugin test`, `objectstack config set`, or any other phantom `os`/`objectstack` command presented as runnable survives. Remaining `objectstack upgrade …` snippets at lifecycle.mdx:402, 422, 440, 873-874, 880, 888 are all pre-existing and are covered by the top callout (:9-17) which now states explicitly that no such line is runnable; they are upgrade-class, not the install-class defect of #21444. `os package publish <older-artifact> --env <env-id> --install` (lifecycle.mdx:561) is TRUE per item 7; the `os rollback` mention (:565) is stated as removed, consistent with no `rollback.ts` under `packages/cli/src/commands/`. The "Installation Flow (design)" TypeScript (:208-261), "Installation States (design)" (:263-278) and "Dependency Resolution" (:280-316) are now framed as design by the section callout (:197-204) and the one `objectstack plugin install ${pkg}` string in the error message was removed. No FALSE residual of the defect class found.

Merge-cleanliness: `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main 238b5972…` exits 0 and writes tree `9b23e03e0139e6f0cd8eb6e1e19c18882f1780e6` — no conflicts against fetched origin/main.

### ② Semver level

Docs only: the single changed file is `content/docs/protocol/kernel/lifecycle.mdx`; no package source, exports, spec keys or config fields change, so nothing publishes. No changeset is owed (AGENTS.md:1072 "Add a changeset for anything that publishes" — this publishes nothing), and the PR adds none, which is correct. Clause-②: not applicable — no ADR-0087 disposition is triggered because nothing authorable is removed or renamed; the page's status text matches ADR-0025's existing status line rather than amending it.

### ③ Boundary flags

No FALSE items. No boundary crossed: the PR does not touch `content/docs/releases/`, any `CHANGELOG.md`, any ADR, or `packages/cli/`; every command it names as real is registered under `packages/cli/src/commands/` and documented in `packages/cli/README.md`, and every command it names as absent is absent. The PR closes #21444 within scope (one page, prose only).
